params.description: Confidence-interval construction for the RELATIVE effect (m13 STAT-4). 'delta' (default, legacy parity) is the Wald interval effect ± z·SE with the variance evaluated at the estimate — a different test from the absolute p-value beside it, so the two can disagree about the same hypothesis. 'fieller' inverts the score test at every candidate lift: asymmetric, coherent with the absolute p-value BY CONSTRUCTION, exact coverage, and honestly unbounded when the control mean is not distinguishable from zero. Identity-bearing — opting in starts a new results series.
